identity: A Jordanian school social-studies (اجتماعيات) multiple-choice quiz bank of 20 items, punctuation stripped, with each item occupying its own <NL>-delimited line. Every item is a stem (a question, or a definition awaiting its label) followed immediately by 3 to 5 answer options carrying no lettering, no numbering and no connective between them. The typing is informal: اريد for اربد at 10, spaced particles ب at 25 and و at 17/265/296, Arabic-Indic numerals, and a missing ت in ربيع اول at 47-48 for تربيع اول. This is genre I of my doctrine — the MCQ exam bank that scored 33.3 in batch 1 because I read it as running prose. Here the <NL> tokens hand me the item boundaries for free, so the whole task is the stem/option split and the option/option splits inside each line.
law: The unit is the stem and each option — not the grammatical sentence. Five rules, all from doctrine section I. (1) THE STEM ENDS WHERE THE OPTIONS BEGIN, even mid-construction: a trailing copula هي, a dangling preposition في or على or ب, a dangling complementiser بأنه, or a stranded counted noun محافظة or قارة is a colon in disguise (I2, H1). (2) EVERY option is its own unit whatever its length, one word or five; the short-tail rule 0b is suspended in this genre (I3). (3) Boundaries fall BETWEEN siblings, never inside one — an option internal و, idafa or adjective keeps the option whole (I5, and the conjunct-weight test of section 0: و plus a bare noun is never a cut). (4) The detection signal is N consecutive constituents of the same syntactic type and similar length with zero connectives; three or four such siblings means an option list, so cut before each (I4). (5) A long stem stays ONE unit — its internal و and كما clauses are subordinate description feeding a single sentence-final predicate, and the task-block granularity governs (I1, J3). Corollary from checklist item 4: default is CUT and I must justify every non-cut, since my prior is 7 to 1 wrong in the merge direction.
reasoning: NINE contested sites. (a) Item 1, indices 10-18. The eight place names alternate perfectly unmarked/و-marked: اريد | ومأدبا | معان | وكرك | جرش | والبلقاء | مادبا | و الزرقاء. That alternation defines four sibling PAIRS of governorates, not eight singletons. My own law forbids the shredded reading outright — و plus a bare noun is never a boundary (section 0, I5) — so the only cuts available are the three asyndetic junctions at 11/13/15, giving the four options this document overwhelmingly prefers. اريد at 10 is اربد (Irbid), confirmed by the correctly spelled إربد at 37. (b) Item 2, index 25. Two parses compete: stem ending at المزروعات with الري ب التنقيط as option 1, versus stem ending at the stranded ب with التنقيط, الرش, القنوات as three bare options. I take the second. The three siblings are then perfectly parallel bare irrigation-method nouns (I4), whereas the first parse yields a three-token option beside two one-token options. And a stranded ب is precisely the pattern my doctrine already paid for in gold: بحق المال العام ل ‖ مجلسي الأعيان والنواب. Marked med — this is my least certain cut. (c) Item 4, index 47. I do NOT split ربيع اول. It is تربيع اول, the first-quarter moon phase, one option; اول alone is not a moon phase. Three options here, as in item 2. (d) Item 6, the 29-token definition stem at 66-94. This is the site where prose instinct would destroy me. مجموعة من الأفراد يعيشون معا ... ويرتبطون ... كما يوجد أحكام تنظم علاقاته بعضهم ببعض هي ___ is a SINGLE nominal sentence: يعيشون and ويرتبطون are صفات of the indefinite مجموعة (relative clauses, and my table rules الذي never opens a unit), and كما يوجد adds a further property of the same subject. Nothing predicates until هي at 94. Cutting at 74 or 86 would sever the subject from its predicate and leave هي الأسرة headless. Genre beats the و/كما default here (I1, J3, and the H4 principle that description with no independent predication merges). One cut only, at the copula 94. (e) Items 13 and 17, indices 204 and 252. The counted nouns محافظة and قارة sit stranded at the end of their stems with numerals following (اثنتي عشرة / خمسة عشر / أربعة عشر / عشر, and خمسة / ستة / سبعة / ثمانية). These two items corroborate each other: same construction, same split point. The compound teens are single numerals — no cut inside اثنتي عشرة or خمسة عشر — and the bare عشر at 211 is the fourth option, which is exactly what makes the count come out at four. (f) The dangling-stem family, all high confidence and all the free points my checklist item 2 promises: هي at 57, هي at 94, في at 114, بأنه at 179, على at 216, هي at 242. Each is a function word that cannot end a sentence, with parallel siblings immediately after. (g) Multi-token options I deliberately keep whole: وادي الأردن at 125-126, التفكك الأسري and التوافق الأسري at 96-99, الأبيض المتوسط at 217-218, المملكة العربية السعودية at 270-272, استعد لعبور الشارع at 59-61, and every number-plus-unit pair ٤٨ كم / ٤١٠ م. Splitting any of these would break I5 and wreck the four-sibling count that validates the parse. (h) Item 20, index 296. The و in حدوده البرية مع الدول المجاورة و منافذه البحرية joins two bare NPs both governed by بطول — zero own predication, so the conjunct-weight test returns no cut, exactly like القمح والشعير at 9 and الجنوب و الشرق at 265. Stem runs to البحرية at 298. (i) Item 20, index 302. Is it كثرة | قلة | عدم وجود | العقبة (four) or كثرة | قلة | عدم وجود العقبة (three)? I cut, taking four. Seventeen of the twenty items in this document have exactly four options, the four constituents are then all short bare nouns of similar weight (I4), and عدم وجود العقبة is an incoherent distractor for a slot that wants كثرة/قلة/عدم وجود before منافذه البحرية, whereas العقبة alone is a plausible sloppy distractor. Marked med. FINAL CHECK: 98 units over 285 non-<NL> tokens, about 2.9 tokens per unit — right for a bank that is mostly one-word options. All 19 pre-<NL> tokens and the final token 303 carry boundaries; no <NL> token carries one.
